critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1578 lines — split into routers (auth, geo, discover, waitlist, profile) recommended.
Waitlist endpoint is public and unrate-limited — consider adding IP-based rate-limit (e.g. 5/min) to prevent abuse.
Discover $geoNear uses maxDistance = (radius_km or 500)*1000. Good. Consider capping the aggregate $limit to a smaller value when radius is very small (currently always 500 candidates) for perf.
clear_public correctly hides coords/_score/_distance_m — verified. Consider a snapshot unit test to lock the public contract.

PATCH /profile/me: when body.comuna is sent alone, `country` defaults to 'CL' (comuna catalog is CL-only). This overrides an existing non-CL country, which matches the spec but is a subtle side-effect — worth documenting in the endpoint docstring.
